verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents an official MCP Server that lets AI agents work with its payment platform in natural language, including querying and analyzing transactions conversationally. The MCP page also lists virtual card issuance and spend controls as capabilities. However, natural-language operation requires bringing your own AI agent, and the server is described as querying a 'designated set' of Core API endpoints, so its scope is limited. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface that works without a user-supplied agent, clear evidence that write operations (issuing cards, setting controls) work through natural language beyond feature listings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
